quote: For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
claim: 其核心是多头注意力：将查询、键、值用不同的学习到的线性投影映射 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；作者采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
claim: 作者还做了模型变体实验，在英德开发集 newstest2013 上评估不同注意力头数、键维度、模型规模、dropout 和位置编码的影响 [S6.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步（12 小时），big 模型训练 300,000 步（3.5 天）[S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步（12 小时），big 模型训练 300,000 步（3.5 天）[S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 上，RAG 3-way 分类结果与最优模型差距在 4.3% 以内，且无需检索监督 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.
claim: 其动机是混合模型可直接修订和扩展知识，且访问的知识可被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence 和 BART，人工评估显示 RAG 更事实、更具体 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试添加“空文档”机制但未发现性能提升，因此省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
claim: 残差学习下情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比其普通对应网络将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型不应比其较浅对应模型产生更高训练误差，但实验表明现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层更准确，未观察到退化问题，并从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 此外，在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测基线实验 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当网络能够开始收敛后，随着深度增加会出现退化问题——准确率饱和并迅速下降，且该退化并非由过拟合引起，增加层数反而导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习在最小化人工标注依赖的情况下自我演化出推理能力 [S1.p2]。

quote: their performance is inherently capped by the human-provided exemplars, which prevents the exploration of superior, non-human-like reasoning pathways
claim: 现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类提供的示例，无法探索更优的非人类推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: we abstain from applying neural reward models—whether outcome-based or process-based—to reasoning tasks
claim: 奖励系统由准确率奖励和格式奖励组成，不使用神经奖励模型 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p4]。

quote: by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: from 50% to 57% on AIME24
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 消融实验覆盖数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 二是测试时扩展方法 budget forcing，通过强制追加思考结束符来限制最大思考 token，或抑制结束符并追加“Wait”来延长思考 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It performs significantly better than our base model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) despite just training it on an additional 1,000 samples.
claim: s1-32B 是最样本高效的开源数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 个样本就显著优于基座模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: LIMO reaches 96.3% accuracy compared to QwQ-32B-Preview’s 83.6%.
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；在 MATH500 达到 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；在 AMC23 达到 96.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Similar improvements are observed on other challenging benchmarks such as CHMath (84.2% vs 68.5%) and GradeSchool (76.2% vs 63.8%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基模型的 45.3%；在 CHMath 达到 84.2% 对 68.5%，在 GradeSchool 达到 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k, a randomly selected 100k subset of NuminaMath-CoT
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview、Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，大基准使用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的基准生成 4 个样本并计算无偏 pass@1 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: This meticulous process yields a compact yet potent dataset of just 800 training samples.
claim: 方法包括严格的数据筛选流程：从大规模 QA 池中先做粗难度过滤，再做细粒度难度评估，并进行知识点多样化，同时按逻辑连贯性、步骤清晰度和解答正确性筛选推理链，最终得到 800 条训练样本 [S1.p4]。

quote: All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
claim: 实验使用 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。

quote: Due to budget constraints, we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.
claim: 主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 成本，每实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

quote: 3. Environment feedback should be informative but concise.
claim: 设计遵循四条原则：动作简单易懂、动作紧凑高效、环境反馈信息丰富但简洁、guardrails 缓解错误传播 [S2.p5]。

quote: SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，随后进入“编辑-执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；51.7% 的轨迹出现至少一次编辑失败，单次失败后最终成功概率从 90.5% 降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]；成功运行比失败运行更早、更便宜地结束 [S5.SS2.p5]；约一半未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

quote: out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
claim: 行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，随后进入“编辑-执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；51.7% 的轨迹出现至少一次编辑失败，单次失败后最终成功概率从 90.5% 降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]；成功运行比失败运行更早、更便宜地结束 [S5.SS2.p5]；约一半未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

quote: We instead ask, if reasoning is implicit in all text, why shouldn’t we leverage the task of language modeling to teach reasoning?
claim: 作者提出，既然推理隐含在所有文本中，为什么不利用语言建模任务本身来教模型推理 [S1.p1]。

quote: In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
claim: Quiet-STaR 会带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。

quote: it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
claim: 此外，作者指出无法确知模型用语言表达的推理是否忠实反映其内部处理，且没有防止有害或有偏推理模式的保障 [Sx1.p1]。

quote: We insert learned <| startofthought |> and <| endofthought |> tokens to mark each rationale’s start and end.
claim: 算法分三步：在输入序列的 n 个 token 上并行生成 r 条长度为 t 的理由，并用可学习的 <|startofthought|> 和 <|endofthought|> token 标记起止 [S4.SS1.p1]；用混合头（浅层 MLP）输出权重，决定后理由预测 logits 与基础 LM logits 的混合程度 [S4.SS1.p1]；用 REINFORCE 根据理由对未来 token 预测的贡献优化理由生成参数 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
claim: 作者承认，为解决问题所做的简化之一是尚未验证这些技术是否适用于从零开始训练的模型，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。

quote: To minimize costs, we restrict the number of attempts per issue to 250, with all attempts made independently of one another.
claim: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 各取 128 个随机测试题，MiniF2F-MATH 取 130 个形式化自 MATH 的测试题，CodeContests 取 140 个无图像标签的测试题，SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架 [S2.p4][S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: 5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
claim: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 各取 128 个随机测试题，MiniF2F-MATH 取 130 个形式化自 MATH 的测试题，CodeContests 取 140 个无图像标签的测试题，SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架 [S2.p4][S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: 3. MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset.
claim: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 各取 128 个随机测试题，MiniF2F-MATH 取 130 个形式化自 MATH 的测试题，CodeContests 取 140 个无图像标签的测试题，SWE-bench Lite 使用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 和 Moatless Tools 框架 [S2.p4][S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
claim: 作者用无偏估计公式计算 pass@k 作为覆盖率指标，并在有自动验证器的任务中直接将其作为成功率 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: We start by adopting the same function class, but now modelling the log of coverage $c$ as a function of the number of samples $k$: $\displaystyle\log(c)\approx ak^{b}$
claim: 此外，作者尝试用指数幂律 log(c) ≈ a k^b 建模覆盖率与样本数的关系 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过由微调模型保持的最优结果 [S1.p11]。

quote: We use the same model and architecture as GPT-2
claim: 模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但使用交替的稠密与局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 论文训练了 GPT-3，一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型，参数量是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。

quote: mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$
claim: 在新闻生成上，人类评估者识别 1750 亿参数模型生成文章的准确率仅约 52%，接近随机水平 [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

quote: GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
claim: GPT-3 在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上也表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术和在只见过一次定义后使用新词 [S1.p12]。

quote: We use a vocabulary with 128K tokens.
claim: 模型采用标准稠密 Transformer 架构，仅做少量修改，如使用分组查询注意力（GQA）和 128K 词表 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: Llama 3 also delivers a much better balance between helpfulness and harmlessness than its predecessor.
claim: 实验评估表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先语言模型表现相当，并接近最先进水平 [S1.p6]。

quote: We pre-train Llama 3 on a corpus of about 15T multilingual tokens, compared to 1.8T tokens for Llama 2.
claim: 预训练阶段在约 15T 多语言 tokens 上训练 405B 参数模型，使用 8K 上下文窗口，随后通过继续预训练将上下文窗口扩展至 128K tokens [S2.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
claim: 安全方面，没有任何测试能保证穷尽所有可能的风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其是在英语之外的语言中，或被熟练的对抗性红队人员通过提示工程诱导 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。

quote: The Llama 3 Herd of models natively supports multilinguality, coding, reasoning, and tool usage.
claim: 论文旨在开发一套新的语言基础模型 Llama 3，使其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
claim: 在 OCRBench_v2 上，Qwen2.5-VL 模型在英文和中文赛道上分别大幅超过最佳模型 Gemini 1.5-Pro 达 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.
claim: 在视频基准评估中，每个视频分析的最大帧数被限制为 768 帧，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超越此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知差以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: Then, we evaluate the model’s performance across various sub-capabilities.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.p1]。

quote: Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos
claim: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合与预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间，而非 LLM 的文本输出空间 [S1.p1]。

quote: First is the cinematic split, which includes clips that are professionally produced that often contains both diegetic and non-diegetic sounds (ambient and theme music).
claim: 音频模型在约 100 万小时音频上预训练，并在电影级数据与高质量音频数据上微调，评测覆盖 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 及新提出的 Movie Gen Audio Bench 等 [S2.p2][S6.SS2.SSS3.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。

quote: We adopt the flow-matching based generative models and the diffusion transformer (DiT) model architecture.
claim: 音频模型同样采用 Flow Matching 与 DiT 架构，条件输入包括视频、音频上下文和文本 [S6.SS1.p1]。

quote: artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
claim: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在伪影 [S8.p2]。

quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
claim: 在文本到视频生成上，Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 为中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。

quote: Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet
claim: 聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，性能与 GPT-4o、Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等领先闭源模型相当 [S1.p5][S5.SS3.SSS2.p1]。

quote: these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware.
claim: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。
